issues.description: Visibility of Farm.singFarmSongVerse differs between artifacts: the problem UML and the provided template declare singFarmSongVerse as private, but the solution implementation declares it as protected. This inconsistency in method visibility could confuse students about the intended access level and the encapsulation design of the Farm helper method.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent across artifacts. Prefer changing the solution's singFarmSongVerse method declaration to private to match the UML and template (private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)), or update the UML and template to indicate protected if broader access is intended.
